title: Shoprite keeps just R6 of every R100 #Shoprite
text:
In its last financial year the Shoprite group sold almost R271 billion of goods, about R5 billion every week. But of every R100 a shopper spends, Shoprite keeps only about R6 as trading profit. So how does a business that keeps so little of each sale end up worth close to R200 billion? The lesson up front: a small fee is not small when the amount is small.

Full guide: "How Shoprite Makes Money: R6 of Every R100 (and Why It's in Every Town)" on the Money From Zero channel.
